[[4,1,1]] · Core-X

In the computational basis, single-X errors have distinguishable ideal syndromes. ZIII is a weight-one logical error. Raw triple-Z faces act as logical Z: separately measuring them is not equivalent to measuring a safe pair product.

5-bit repetition + 4 ancillas · Core-X5

Sixteen clean X patterns of weight at most two decode in the ideal model. For one incoming X and one named X-type extraction fault, 800 labeled cases release 750 zero-X and 50 one-X residuals. A released boundary is correctable within the model; it is not a clean-state certificate.

Thirty weight-two + new-X witnesses produce residual logical XXXXX. General Pauli fault tolerance is not established: the prior 120-case audit found 24 multi-data hooks and 80 phase-bearing outcomes.

Forty simulator fault labels include duplicate operational effects. The replay is deterministic conformance, not a memory benchmark or proof of phase protection.

Subsystem [[8,1,3]] · three gauge qubits

Memory table withdrawn: schedule/recovery JSON and full raw-trial outputs are absent. No replayable memory-performance result is published.

The Stim notebook enumerates phase-quotiented Pauli labels, verifies center rank four and gauge rank ten, and finds no dressed logical of weight one or two. The weight-three witness is IIIIIXXZ. This establishes code algebra, not noisy extraction or composition.

The new ideal-center reference decoder corrects all 24 single-data Pauli errors with ideal syndrome information. It is not the missing historical flag decoder or a restoration of the memory simulation.

Restricted entangler search

Source-reported enumeration; not rerun in this release. No gauge-preserving logical entangler was found in the listed families.

Two-block pairwise Clifford search families
FamilyMaps testedGauge-preservingEntangling
Identical two-qubit symplectic Clifford map on all eight corresponding pairs72020
Pair-specific {I, CNOT A-to-B, CNOT B-to-A, CZ}65,53610
Same pair-specific alphabet, plus SWAP390,62520

These counts do not exclude arbitrary circuits, non-Clifford gates, ancilla-assisted methods, or temporary-gauge surgery. A complete noisy logical CNOT remains unestablished. Conditional lemma and evidence boundary.
